rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and appropriately notes limits of a single static image, but it somewhat second-guesses the provided 3AA lab grade and adds mild asymmetry/under-expansion impressions that may not be firmly supported.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, diagnosis, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, prior IVF history, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible probability range tied to embryo and patient factors; minor tension exists between calling the case good prognosis while repeatedly downgrading the image-based morphology.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET at age 35 with a good day-5 blastocyst, avoidance of unnecessary add-ons, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor speculative points (e.g., freeze-all discussion) are not central.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for the current transfer and sensible future-cycle planning, including SET, lifestyle modification, luteal support review, and when to escalate evaluation.
